currencies.name: Gold Piece
currencies.short: Universal reserve. 1 gold = 10 silver = 100 copper. Bank vault standard.
currencies.description: Universal trade gold. Accepted everywhere because purity, weight, and value are internationally recognized.
currencies.player_tip: Universal reserve. Everything converts to gold.

currencies.name: Silver Piece
currencies.short: Everyday market coin. 1 silver = 10 copper.
currencies.description: Everyday trade silver. Common for wages, road expenses, and market produce.
currencies.player_tip: Street-price coin. 1 gold = 10 silver.

currencies.name: Copper Bit
currencies.short: Small change. Bread, ferry tips, small supplies.
currencies.description: Low-value street currency used for daily living expenses.
currencies.player_tip: 100 copper bits equal 1 gold.

currencies.name: Midland Ducat
currencies.short: Regal Empire main coin. Stable, standardized treasury tender.
currencies.description: The official coin of the Regal Empire, backed by the imperial military and tax collectors.
currencies.player_tip: Standard currency across the Midlands.

currencies.name: Imperial Crown
currencies.short: Heavy state coin backed by imperial army and tax office.
currencies.description: Heavy gold-alloy coin used for high-value state contracts and military procurement.
currencies.player_tip: Accepted at a premium in official imperial ports.

currencies.name: Archive Clearance Writ
currencies.short: Restricted clearance writ for classified archives and sealed vaults.
currencies.description: Sealed parchment document permitting access to restricted records, classified vaults, and high-tier research.
currencies.player_tip: Waluigi values these above gold for record acquisition.

currencies.name: Dwarven Oathgold
currencies.short: Dwarven oath-stamped pure gold. High intrinsic purity.
currencies.description: Pure gold ingot stamped with dwarven clan oaths and anvil runes.
currencies.player_tip: Worth 4x normal gold at smiths and jewelers.

currencies.name: Mora
currencies.short: Catalyst and currency from Teyvat. Universally accepted in foreign trade.
currencies.description: Physical currency minted in Liyue, doubling as an elemental catalyst for craftsmanship.
currencies.player_tip: Essential for Teyvat merchants and alchemy shops.

currencies.name: Hyrulean Rupee
currencies.short: Cut gemstone currency in green, blue, red, and silver varieties.
currencies.description: Naturally luminous crystal gems cut into precision hexagonal shapes for commerce.
currencies.player_tip: Higher-value red and purple rupees convert faster.

currencies.name: PokéDollar
currencies.short: League-regulated currency for medical supplies, balls, and travel.
currencies.description: Regulated card and paper currency backed by the international Pokémon League.
currencies.player_tip: Standard currency across all regional PokéMarts.

currencies.name: Mushroom Coin
currencies.short: Traditional Mushroom Kingdom gold coin with star emblem.
currencies.description: Classic yellow coin stamped with the Mushroom Kingdom crest. Widely used despite civil war strain.
currencies.player_tip: Accepted everywhere in Toad Town and Mushroom province.

currencies.name: Peach Crown
currencies.short: Rebel restoration coin issued by Captain Toadette's quartermasters.
currencies.description: Gold coin minted in Bramblehaven bearing Princess Peach's silhouette.
currencies.player_tip: Commands heavy discounts at Loyalist quartermasters.

currencies.name: Toad Rebuilding Bond
currencies.short: Community rebuilding bond backed by refugee councils.
currencies.description: Paper credit issued by Liberated Toads to fund food, shelter repairs, and medical aid.
currencies.player_tip: Toad Lee uses these to coordinate regional relief.

currencies.name: Relief Stamp
currencies.short: Ration and shelter voucher issued for emergency supplies.
currencies.description: Perforated stamp used for rationing food, medical gauze, and basic tools.
currencies.player_tip: Crucial currency for displaced civilians and emergency gear.

currencies.name: Regal Decree Strip
currencies.short: Magistrate paper strip authorizing court fees, fines, and filings.
currencies.description: Official wax-sealed strip used in Imperial courts, parliamentary filings, and bail bonds.
currencies.player_tip: Speaker L and legal clerks trade heavily in decree strips.

currencies.name: Beanbean Bean Coin
currencies.short: Bean-shaped green coin from the Beanbean Kingdom.
currencies.description: Curved bean-shaped coin made of polished bronze-gold alloy, favored in southern trade.
currencies.player_tip: Great for purchasing Beanbean delicacies and chucklehuck brew.

currencies.name: Courier Whistle Token
currencies.short: Carved wooden whistle token redeemable for priority courier service.
currencies.description: Small carved whistle used by the Toad Network to dispatch emergency couriers.
currencies.player_tip: Waluigi keeps these to ensure instant dossier delivery.

currencies.name: Wario Coin
currencies.short: Gold coin stamped with Wario's face. Backed by greed.
currencies.description: Heavy gold-brass coin minted by Wario Enterprise. Wario demands 20% markup when spending it.
currencies.player_tip: Accepted at all Wario outlets and garlic guilds.

currencies.name: Wario Shop Credit
currencies.short: Quest board reward points redeemable at Wario's Warehouse.
currencies.description: Digital and token shop points issued for completing quest board contracts for Wario.
currencies.player_tip: Directly spendable for items, weapons, and vehicles in Wario's shop!

currencies.name: Bowser Bux
currencies.short: Koopa military scrip backed by Bowser's fortresses and airships.
currencies.description: Heavy iron-plated scrip notes issued to Koopa soldiers, Hammer Bros, and mechanics.
currencies.player_tip: Bowser holds 50,000 Bowser Bux in military reserves.

currencies.name: Shell Command Credit
currencies.short: Siege engineering credit for Koopa armorers and Magikoopa labs.
currencies.description: Specialized requisition credit for heavy armor, shell repairs, and Magikoopa scrolls.
currencies.player_tip: Used for siege engine upgrades and shell plating.

currencies.name: Banana Medallion
currencies.short: Heavy brass medallion from Kongo Bongo representing stored banana reserves.
currencies.description: Durable metal medallion minted in DK Isles that never rots or spoils.
currencies.player_tip: Highly valued in tropical ports and island bazaars.

currencies.name: Coconut Oil Bar
currencies.short: Standardized pressed coconut oil bar used in island maritime trade.
currencies.description: Dense commodity bar used for ship waterproofing, cooking oil, and island currency.
currencies.player_tip: Easily tradable at all maritime docks.

currencies.name: Kremling Koin
currencies.short: Crude iron coin minted by King K. Rool's raiders.
currencies.description: Rough iron coin stamped with a crocodile skull, used in pirate dens and Kremling hideouts.
currencies.player_tip: Used on the black market for stolen military hardware.

currencies.name: Syrup Doubloon
currencies.short: Heavy gold pirate coin from Captain Syrup's fleet.
currencies.description: Stolen and reminted gold coin widely circulated among privateers and contraband smugglers.
currencies.player_tip: Preferred payment for black market maps and stolen cannons.

currencies.name: Cargo Share Draft
currencies.short: Draft backed by captured cargo hauls in pirate warehouses.
currencies.description: Promissory note representing a fractional share of looted shipping crates.
currencies.player_tip: Can be redeemed for raw goods, spices, and salvaged gear.

currencies.name: Arcane Shard
currencies.short: Crystallized mana shard used for enchanting and spell casting.
currencies.description: Luminous crystal containing stabilized magical energy. Used directly in spellcraft or as currency.
currencies.player_tip: Primary currency for purchasing spell scrolls and wands.

currencies.name: Mages Guild Seal
currencies.short: Stamped Guild token redeemable for rare spell components and research.
currencies.description: Heavy silver-and-amethyst seal stamped with the Archmage's sigil.
currencies.player_tip: Required for high-level guild passes and restricted grimoires.

currencies.name: Planar Transit Stamp
currencies.short: Authorized stamp for portal transit, teleport circles, and dimensional travel.
currencies.description: Enchanted wax stamp verifying authorization and hazard insurance for planar transit.
currencies.player_tip: Essential for inter-realm travel and dimensional transport.

currencies.name: Astral Pearl
currencies.short: Rare pearl harvested from astral currents during dimensional storms.
currencies.description: Iridescent sphere formed from compressed planar residue in the astral sea.
currencies.player_tip: Sells for extreme value at wizard academies.

currencies.name: Kivotos Credit
currencies.short: Electronic currency used across Kivotos academy-city schools and clubs.
currencies.description: Digital credit system managed by the General Student Union across all academy districts.
currencies.player_tip: Remi holds 5,000 Kivotos Credits in digital reserves.

currencies.name: Millennium Data Chit
currencies.short: Encrypted memory token redeemable for compute time and tech prototypes.
currencies.description: High-density data chit storing encrypted schematics, compute hours, and lab access rights.
currencies.player_tip: Used to buy siege constructs, ammo, and robotics gear.

currencies.name: Encrypted Credstick
currencies.short: Portable hardware stick holding encrypted digital currency.
currencies.description: Handheld chip containing cryptographically secured funds for internet and sci-fi markets.
currencies.player_tip: Instantly spendable at all online or tech-integrated vendors.

currencies.name: Soul Coin
currencies.short: Lower-plane infernal iron coin trapping a living soul. High value, dark moral cost.
currencies.description: Heavy coin forged from infernal iron that whispers with the soul trapped inside it.
currencies.player_tip: Worth 20 gold pieces on the black market. Archie holds 3.

currencies.name: Preserved Blood Vial
currencies.short: Sealed alchemy vial of alchemically preserved blood for vampire markets.
currencies.description: Crystal vial of blood graded by lineage, purity, and magical resonance.
currencies.player_tip: Standard currency in Shadow Estate dinner exchanges.

currencies.name: Shadow Obol
currencies.short: Cold obsidian coin used by servants, hunters, and ghosts in the Shadowfell.
currencies.description: Flat obsidian coin etched with fading sigils, absorbed from planar shadow fields.
currencies.player_tip: Used to bribe Shadow Estate guards and buy servant-pass keys.

currencies.name: Corvinarus Favor Marker
currencies.short: Formal favor marker issued by vampire patriarchs.
currencies.description: Carved bone marker bearing the Corvinarus crest, representing an aristocratic blood favor.
currencies.player_tip: Redeemable for safe passage or assassination contracts.

currencies.name: Archive Index Token
currencies.short: Archivist token for viewing, copying, and stealing restricted records.
currencies.description: Heavy lead token issued by the Shadow Estate Archivist for catalog access.
currencies.player_tip: Used in the Shadow Estate library to unlock secret dossiers.

currencies.name: Warpstone Token
currencies.short: Refined chaos crystal token. Corrupting, illegal, and extremely valuable.
currencies.description: Glowing green crystal token emitting mutagenic chaos radiation.
currencies.player_tip: Valued by dark mages, Skaven engineers, and forbidden cults.

currencies.name: Broker Information Mark
currencies.short: Underworld mark redeemable for blackmail, intel, and silence.
currencies.description: Dark metal token stamped with a magnifying glass over a coin, used by The Broker's network.
currencies.player_tip: Redeemable for high-grade political intelligence.

currencies.name: Tea Leaf Syndicate Chit
currencies.short: Private bank chit used in smuggling networks and tea houses.
currencies.description: Watermarked paper chit infused with tea essence, issued by Chai T and the Tea Syndicate.
currencies.player_tip: Settles contraband debts without paper trails.

currencies.name: Rakasha Spirit Bead
currencies.short: Carved amber or bone bead infused with spirit ancestor blessing.
currencies.description: Smooth bead worn on necklaces, carved by Rakasha shamans and artisans.
currencies.player_tip: Traded among spirit warriors and beast tamers.

currencies.name: Feyward Promise Acorn
currencies.short: Gilded acorn binding a fey court hospitality promise.
currencies.description: Golden acorn that hums when touched, representing a formal vow in the Feyward.
currencies.player_tip: Bypasses fey memory-loss curses when traded.

currencies.name: Gilded Court Leaf
currencies.short: Preserved golden leaf used to settle noble debts in Feyward courts.
currencies.description: Ever-golden oak leaf stamped with court heraldry, used for aristocrat hospitality debts.
currencies.player_tip: Used to negotiate treaties with fey lords.

currencies.name: Autumnwood Orchard Mark
currencies.short: Provincial timber and orchard harvest trade mark.
currencies.description: Bronze leaf token used across Autumnwood orchards and timber mills.
currencies.player_tip: Buys food, wood, and cider at local provincial markets.
